coverage: Partial source findings; not a complete baseline or adjacent release contract review.

records.findings: Login reads username/password, returns Ok. for existing or newly authenticated session, Fails. on wrong credentials, throws access denied when banned. Logout ends session. Public login route; protected controller actions require a session.
records.live_status: Successful WebUI login and HTTP 200 capture confirmed; negative cases untested.

records.findings: Action name plus Action suffix is invoked through Qt metaobject. Unknown method throws NotFound. AccessDenied, BadData, BadParams, Conflict and NotFound map to corresponding HTTP exceptions. GET query and POST parameter extraction differ; Host/cross-site validation precedes dispatch. Preserve valid Host and origin rather than disable protections.

4.1.0 serializes categories as a list of names, not a name-to-object map. Torrent state is keyed by hash and includes per-torrent serialization; server_state contains transfer info, queueing, alternate-speed mode and refresh interval. rid selects incremental response.
records.live_status: Empty full sync observed in compatibility/evidence/qbt-4.1.0-baseline.json; categories array, torrents object, tags absent. Populated and incremental behavior unverified.

records.findings: 4.1.0 uses RSSRefreshInterval, RSSMaxArticlesPerFeed, RSSProcessingEnabled, RSSAutoDownloadingEnabled and unconditionally passes their values to setters even when absent. 4.1.1 replaces them with rss_refresh_interval, rss_max_articles_per_feed, rss_processing_enabled, rss_auto_downloading_enabled and guards setters by presence. Unrelated sparse writes on 4.1.0 risk RSS changes; preserve all four original values or gate the operation if preservation cannot be guaranteed. Backend effects still need review and isolated live testing.

4.1.0 constructs TorrentFilter with AnyHash; 4.1.1 reads hashes split by | and uses it when nonempty. Client targeting selected hashes on 4.1.0 must filter returned list locally, not assume server enforcement.
4.1.1 adds explicit Moving -> moving serialization case absent in 4.1.0. Backend state availability and fallback need review.

Absent in 4.1.4 controller; 4.1.5 requires hash, origUrl, newUrl. 5.1.4 uses the same names. 5.2.0 replaces origUrl with url and permits newUrl and/or tier. The client separates tracker URL syntax, tier editing, and selected reannounce. Intermediate backend/helper and exact response contracts remain pending.

5.1.4 lacks pieceAvailability and setComment; reannounce accepts hashes without using urls. 5.2.0 introduces both actions and optional percent-decoded selected tracker urls. Do not substitute all-tracker reannounce for a selected operation. Backend/build restrictions and exact responses remain pending.

5.2.4 controller lacks action; 5.3.0 requires path and returns decimal qint64 text. Backend path/error semantics remain pending. Existing API 2.16.0 gate retained with stable daemon corroboration; declared 5.3.0 API version is 2.16.2.

All 26 distinct sync controller revisions covering 68 releases reviewed for collection shape. 4.1.0–4.1.2 serialize QVariantList names; 4.1.3 introduces QVariantHash definitions with name/savePath. processMap/processList emit additions and categories_removed, not full arrays on incremental responses. Later controllers retain object shape; individual fields and downstream serializers remain open. Normalize arrays at the session boundary to empty definitions without inventing save paths; keep incremental merge and replacement semantics.
records.live_status: Only empty 4.1.0 full snapshot observed; populated/delta real daemon not yet verified.

records.scope: auth/login result and selected dispatcher boundaries
records.findings: Nine distinct auth controller blobs covering every release checked for login result. 4.1.0–5.1.4 set Ok. or Fails. text; 5.2.0+ sets APIStatus::Ok with null data or throws Unauthorized. 5.2.0 webapplication.cpp maps null data to 204 and Unauthorized to 401. Earlier credential hashing, failed attempt reset and ban configuration changed without changing these result strings. Client already accepts 200 Ok. or 204 then authenticated version reads. Scoped fixtures exercise both positive and negative boundary cases with historical SID and QBT_SID-prefixed cookie names. Complete cookie, dispatch, permissions and timeout review remains open.
records.live_status: 4.1.0 successful login observed; remaining authentication cases not live verified.

records.findings: All 33 unique appcontroller revisions inspected. Version and API version return text throughout. BuildInfo absent through 4.1.9.1; 4.2.0 adds qt, libtorrent, boost, openssl, zlib (strings), bitness (integer); 5.0.0 adds platform string; 5.3.1 changes qt from QT_VERSION_STR to Utils::Misc::qtVersionString(). ProcessInfo absent through 5.1.4; 5.2.0 adds launch_time from app launchTimeSecsSinceEpoch. Known absent reads skipped; unknown versions may safely probe read-only endpoints. Missing build fields are not invented. Underlying library helper values and method routing remain pending.
records.live_status: 4.1.0 version and webapiVersion success and buildInfo 404 captured. Other releases not live verified.

records.findings: All 28 distinct webapplication.cpp blobs checked: no session plus nonpublic API route throws ForbiddenHTTPError. This includes expired/removed sessions and does not prove an IP ban or distinguish permission failures. 5.2 introduces port-suffixed QBT_SID_ cookies; earlier default SID, 4.6+ configurable name logic. Qt cookie jar remains per session. Core sync denial stops the affected session and offers reconnect without auto-login; per-operation 403 is not definitive expiry. Test both old and new sessions with explicit expiry and new cookie on reauthentication. Other dispatch and session refresh/backend details remain pending.
records.live_status: Simulated expiry only; real expiry unverified.

records.scope: sync/maindata response IDs, collection updates and selected server-state fields
records.findings: All 26 distinct sync controller revisions inspected for selected maindata assignments. RID cycles 1..1000000; initial request RID 0 requires full_update. 4.1.4 adds free_space_on_disk, 4.2.0 tags, 4.3.0 tracker-to-torrent lists (whole changed URL membership, not additions only), 4.6.0 event-buffer synchronization and use_subcategories, 4.6.1 cached free space, 5.1.0 external addresses, 5.2.0 drops use_subcategories, 5.3.0 adds session_state, request_latency and queued_tracker_announces. Existing client already merges most state fields and clears on full replacement. Validate envelope and all nested collection shapes atomically before advancing RID. Known stable RID range enforced; unknown release permits positive IDs outside historical range. Do not invent missing fields or reject unknown future fields. Remaining serializers/backend meanings and gating of unsupported mutation actions deferred to their relevant audit.
records.live_status: Only empty 4.1.0 snapshot captured; simulated populated delta and recovery tests, pending live verification.

records.scope: sync/torrentPeers action serialization and incremental country state
records.findings: 4.1.0–4.3.0 key built as ip + colon + port; 4.3.1 changes to address helper; 4.3.4 uses TorrentID lookup; 4.4.0 makes files conditional on metadata; 4.5.0 adds peer_id_client and controller-held cursors; 5.2.0 adds host_name/I2P and explicitly empty country fields when disabled; 5.3.0 adds contribution. Earlier serializers omit country fields when disabled and show_flags=false must clear retained values. Client validates boolean envelope and nonempty removal keys before peer delta application; reset only peer cursor on malformed reply. Address-helper details and peer action dispatch remain open.
records.live_status: No real populated peer snapshots yet.
